topics.topic: Interpenetration and Intersection of Solids: Cylinders intersecting cylinders
learningObjectives: Construct lines of intersection between two intersecting right circular cylinders
Use cutting plane and generator methods to plot curves of interpenetration
Determine visibility of intersection lines in orthographic front and plan views

topics.topic: Interpenetration of Prisms and Pyramids: Penetration of dissimilar solid shapes
learningObjectives: Plot curves of interpenetration between square prisms and triangular prisms
Construct lines of intersection between a cone and a horizontal cylinder
Apply intersection geometry to sheet metal ducts and hopper fabrications

topics.topic: Surface Development: Parallel-line development of right and oblique prisms and cylinders
learningObjectives: Explain principles of pattern drafting for sheet metal engineering
Develop the lateral surface of a truncated hexagonal prism using parallel lines
Develop the lateral surface of a truncated cylinder with seam allowances

topics.topic: Surface Development: Radial-line and Triangulation development of cones and hoppers
learningObjectives: Develop the lateral surface of truncated right cones using radial generators
Apply triangulation development to transition pieces (square-to-round hoppers)
Construct true patterns for fabrication of metal funnels and duct adaptors

topics.topic: Mechanical Assembly Drawing: Plummer block, coupling, and machine vice components
learningObjectives: Read exploded and detail drawings of mechanical engineering assemblies
Assemble brasses, cap, bolts, and base casting into a functional plummer block
Draw full-sectional front elevation and plan of assembled machine assemblies

topics.topic: Fasteners in Assembly: ISO metric screw threads, nuts, bolts, keys, and cotters
learningObjectives: Draw conventional representations of internal and external metric screw threads
Construct hexagonal bolt heads and nuts in orthographic projection with chamfers
Draw sunk keys, gib-head keys, and cottered joints with clearance details

topics.topic: Mid-Term Continuous Assessment & Mock Assembly Drafting Clinic
learningObjectives: Evaluate pupil mastery of surface development and assembly sectional views
Grade assembly linework, hatching conventions, and parts list compilation
Remediate common mistakes in thread representation and clearance tolerances

topics.topic: Building Drawing: Detailed sectional elevation from foundation to roof truss
learningObjectives: Draft vertical sectional elevation through an external wall from strip foundation to roof
Represent concrete foundation footing, hardcore, damp-proof course (DPC), and walling
Detail timber king-post or fink roof truss connections and eaves gutters

topics.topic: Building Drawing: Electrical and plumbing layout services plan
learningObjectives: Identify statutory architectural symbols for lighting points, switches, and sockets
Draw domestic electrical installation schematics superimposed on a floor plan
Incorporate water supply piping, waste disposal lines, and septic soakaway layouts

topics.topic: Computer-Aided Design (CAD) Fundamentals: 2D drafting in AutoCAD/LibreCAD
learningObjectives: Navigate CAD user interface: command line, layers, snap modes, and coordinate systems
Execute 2D geometric commands: line, circle, trim, extend, offset, and mirror
Dimension 2D CAD engineering parts and plot drawing sheets to standard PDF scales

topics.topic: Limits, Fits, and Surface Texture Symbols in Engineering Working Drawings
learningObjectives: Explain hole-basis and shaft-basis tolerance systems (clearance, transition, interference)
Interpret ISO tolerance symbols (e.g. H7/g6) on mechanical assembly components
Apply standard surface roughness texture symbols to finished machine faces

topics.topic: Comprehensive WASSCE/NECO Technical Drawing Revision & Past Question Marathon
learningObjectives: Review mechanical and building drawing options for WASSCE Paper 2
Simulate full 3-hour practical board drafting under strict exam conditions
Audit speed, layout positioning, title block lettering, and hatching contrast

topics.topic: Terminal Examination and Final Board Practical Assessment
learningObjectives: Administer mock WASSCE Technical Drawing theory and practical examination
Grade completed drafting sheets according to West African Examination Council rubrics
Record cumulative scores into the school graduation and assessment portal
